description:
Create a draft stock or crypto trade order for user to review.
Use for single-leg equity or crypto buy/sell orders.
This tool returns a draft order only; brokerage execution requires a separate tool.

account_id.description: ID of the brokerage account to trade in, from get_accounts. Omit to use the user's default account.

amount.description: How much to trade: a dollar value when unit is dollars, or a share count when unit is shares.

buy_or_sell.description: Whether to buy or sell the asset.

limit_price.description: Maximum price per share to pay on a buy, or minimum to accept on a sell, in the asset currency. Set for limit and stop_limit orders.

metadata.description: Optional context displayed with the draft trade.

image_url.description: Link to the screenshot or chart the user shared as the source of this trade idea, shown alongside the draft.

order_type.description: How the order is priced. Omit for a market order.

stop_loss.description: Stop-loss exit for Buy entries or OCO Sell orders. Not supported by all brokerages.

unit.description: Absolute price ($) or percent from entry price (%).

stop_price.description: Price per share, in the asset currency, that triggers the order. Set for stop and stop_limit orders.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the asset to trade, e.g. TSLA

take_profit.description: Take-profit exit for Buy entries or OCO Sell orders. Not supported by all brokerages.

unit.description: Absolute price ($) or percent from entry price (%).

time_in_force.description: How long the order stays open: day expires at market close, gtc stays open until canceled. Omit to use the brokerage default.

unit.description: Whether amount is in dollars or shares.

name: create_trade
title: Create Trade
